relationships.subject: Compound 22
relationships.evidence_quote: Biophysical studies by Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) revealed a binding affinity (KD) of 556 nM to human recombinant NLRP3

relationships.subject: Compound 22
relationships.evidence_quote: to suppress the release of interleukin (IL)-1β upon NLRP3 activation

relationships.subject: Compound 22
relationships.evidence_quote: oAβ elevated the expression of NLRP3 compared to the non-treated control microglia, and treatment with 22 significantly decreased NLRP3 expression by 2.5-fold.

relationships.subject: Compound 22
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with 22 at both doses increased mechanical withdrawal threshold and thermal withdrawal latency, suggesting its in vivo efficacy in treating CCI-related neuropathic pain.

key_findings: Triazole-carboxamide compound 22 is a selective, brain-penetrant NLRP3 inhibitor (IC50 70 nM for IL-1beta release; KD 556 nM)
Compound 22 reduced NLRP3 in AD hiPSC glia and relieved pain-like behavior in CCI neuropathic pain mice
